reason: The plugin is a UI-focused DeepSeek Harness extension whose primary purpose is to improve mobile usability of the web settings panel by applying responsive CSS overrides. Evidence from the README and package manifest shows it changes panel structure behavior (full-screen sheet, top tab bar, pinned close button, mobile scrolling adjustments) through a DSH bundle patch, with no stated data, automation, or external integration logic.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页设置面板的移动端 UI 插件，在小屏幕下通过样式覆盖实现更友好的面板布局和顶部导航切换。
summaries.en: This is a mobile-oriented UI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web settings panel that applies responsive styling changes for smaller screens to improve panel layout and navigation behavior.

capabilities: Injects CSS overrides for the DeepSeek Harness web settings panel
Adjusts settings panel layout for small screens (mobile breakpoints)
Reflows navigation and control placement in the panel UI
Requires DSH plugin bundle/patch integration to apply styling changes
